reviewer.role: Acceptance reviewer; did not produce the run answers

case.group_must_observe.1.rationale: Compared all three actual raw answers: the same request-to-return/refund/reconciled-goods-money-receivable boundary; warehouse count/condition with receipt/photos; shift-lead eligibility approval before release; accountant refunds original account after approval; mismatches held before refund; linked records by order ID; only documented evidence and missing authority matrix. All retain five equivalent controls and the same core clarification areas. Chat cites actual text lines (17/19/21/25/29); Word cites section and table rows (3/4/5 counting header); native PDF cites verified page 1 and named rows/sections. Word adds CTL labels and a conditional original-account exception question, PDF adds an analyst English label and original-account verification question; these are presentation/proposal differences, not conflicting source facts.

limitations: Root compared the three fresh-context answers but authored the fixtures/skill; not third-party independent assurance.
One synthetic SOP with a small table and readable native text; not parity for every PDF/Word layout, scan or document complexity.
Format-specific locators and optional analytical wording are intentionally not required to be byte-identical.
Root fixture semantic/render preflight and this model-output comparison are separate checks.
